request: Bare Knuckle Lunatic (goblin-bomber): a muscular goblin brawler who thinks every problem is a fistfight. He holds nothing; his hands are always closed fists. REFERENCE VIDEO: the owner had Runway make one 6 s FRONT-view video and APPROVED both halves. Its frames are in refs/ (Read the pictures with the Read tool): refs/goblin-bomber--front.jpg is his model from the front; refs/goblin-bomber-idle-box-front/frames/idle/f01..f12.jpg is part 1 (0-3 s) and refs/goblin-bomber-idle-box-front/frames/shadow-boxing/f01..f12.jpg is part 2 (3-6 s), 12 evenly spaced frames per 3 s move, time order, f12 = end. FIRST look at all the pictures for a move, then match his BODY and LIMB poses frame by frame: torso lean and twist, head tilt, arm and leg angles, hip height, and the timing (frame N of 12 = N/12 of the clip). This is a rig motion reference only. IGNORE in the video: face and mouth (never animate the face), camera drift, the little step he takes at the very start of the idle part (f01-f03: his feet stay planted), the fists rising in idle f12 (that is the hand-over to part 2, not part of the idle), and the big sliding lunge in shadow-boxing f05 (keep the twist and punch, but the feet stay planted). If refs/ is missing or empty, do NOT write any animation files (the job will be retried). Owner rules for every goblin: nothing goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking); movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty; poses read clearly from above and in front (board game camera). BASE POSE: these clips use "base_pose": "rest", so ctx.key turns are relative to the model's REST pose, a straight, square, front-facing A-pose (same as refs/goblin-bomber--front.jpg). He must face straight forward (+Z, toward the camera) like the video: no overall turn of the hips or root; only the short torso twist inside a punch. SHARED START POSE: both clips start AND end in exactly the same relaxed standing pose, the one in idle f04-f06: feet about shoulder-width apart and flat, knees very slightly bent, upper arms hanging down and a little out from the body, elbows slightly bent, closed fists by his thighs, chest up. Key every bone you change at frame 0 and the last frame with identical values so each clip loops seamlessly and the game can switch between the two clips without a pop. This job makes two NEW clips, OH_Idle_v2 and OH_Idle_ShadowBox. Do not touch, rename or remove the existing clips (OH_Idle etc. stay as they are). Smooth, even game animation.

animations.name: OH_Idle_v2
animations.description: New standing idle, from part 1 'idle' of the video (refs/goblin-bomber-idle-box-front/frames/idle). He stands in the shared start pose and is alive: slow breathing (chest and shoulders rise and fall about twice in 3 s), a gentle side-to-side sway of hips and spine, a soft weight shift from one foot to the other and back (hips move a little over each foot, knees flex slightly, feet never lift or slide), arms hang relaxed with a small counter-swing, fists loosely closed, head steady with a tiny nod. Subtle, calm but tough. Ends exactly in the start pose so it loops seamlessly.

animations.name: OH_Idle_ShadowBox
animations.description: Idle special: shadow boxing like a boxer training, from part 2 'shadow-boxing' of the video (refs/goblin-bomber-idle-box-front/frames/shadow-boxing). From the shared start pose he brings both fists up into a guard in front of his chin (f01), bounces lightly on the balls of his feet (small hip up-down bob, knees springy, toes stay planted, no sliding), and throws practice punches into the air straight toward the camera: left jab (f02), right jab/cross with shoulder turn (f03-f04), left hook with a torso twist (f05), right hook (f06-f07), back to guard (f08), then lowers his fists (f09-f10) and settles back into the shared start pose (f11-f12). Snappy punches with a short hold at full extension, weighty and cartoony. Ends exactly in the start pose so it loops seamlessly.
